correctness.rationale: The weighted Laplacian is positive definite on the n−1-dimensional zero-sum hyperplane. Orthogonal decomposition verifies the four eigenvalues and multiplicities. Strict log-determinant concavity and exact quadratic solve yield the positive design weight and threshold. Two leverage identities verify every root, including strict boundaries. The trace-determinant certificate proves the unique centered minimum; standard uniqueness of Löwner ellipsoids and central symmetry eliminate off-center competitors. A 265-case independently assembled numeric matrix check corroborates every spectral/contact formula but is not an infinite proof.
